captions.detailed: This 3D model is a simple, rectangular open-top container designed to hold business cards or small desktop items. It features a hollow interior with uniform wall thickness and a solid bottom base. The proportions are elongated along the width, with a relatively low height and a narrow depth.
captions.instruction: Design a parametric business card holder box in OpenSCAD. The user should be able to adjust the overall width, height, depth, and wall thickness of the box, as well as add custom embossed text on the front face using the write.scad library with parameters for text name, size, depth, and font style.
captions.factory: The model is built using a difference() boolean operation between two cube primitives: an outer cube defining the overall dimensions (boxWidth, boxDepth, boxHeight) and a slightly smaller, translated inner cube to hollow out the container while preserving the base. Custom text is then added on the front face by translating to the center, rotating 90 degrees around the X-axis, and calling the write() module with parameters for text depth, height, and style.
